groups.name: docs
groups.description: Docs site, project prose and examples. Turns on the docs link check.

groups.name: docs-build
groups.description: The docs site build tool and its workflow and page list. Turns on the docs link check.

groups.name: ui
groups.description: The web UI. Turns on the ui job.

groups.name: helm
groups.description: The Helm chart and the one-file manifests. The chart scenarios end with Go checks in pkg/config and pkg/kubernetes, so those packages turn the chart job on too.

groups.name: go-shared
groups.description: Module files, the entry point, runtime config and every other package. Turns on all Go groups.

groups.name: metadata
groups.description: Repository housekeeping that no build, test or image reads: git ignore lists, editor settings, macOS folder files, code owners and the GitHub issue, pull request and funding forms. Turns on nothing. A file inside another group's folder still turns that group on too.

groups.name: image
groups.description: The release image. Runs no job on a pull request; with any other code group it lets a push to dev or main build its image.

groups.name: ci
groups.description: CI definitions, this change-detection tool, the test lint and the CI scripts (race shards, local CI run). Turns on everything. The docs site workflow and page list belong to docs-build; code owners and the GitHub forms belong to metadata.
